title: CreativeGuard
description: A plugin that prevents staff from smuggling items from creative mode
body:
This plugin helps you to **stop your staff from absuing their creative mode** by creating different inventories for each gamemode.

## what it does:
1) No dropping items in creative
2) No throwing items out of inventory
3) No opening chests in creative
4) Disables /give command
5) Saves survival inventory and restores when gamemode 
is switched(no inventory loss)
6) Wipes creative inventory when switched back to survival


To reload this plugin: 
/cg reload
